label: Read and search messages
description: Open channels and threads, search their history, see who is in them.

label: Mark messages as read
description: Clears your unread counts. Nobody else sees it.

label: Send messages
description: Post and reply in channels. Asks first for someone new, under your guard.

label: Edit your messages
description: Change the text of something you sent.

label: React to messages
description: Add or take back a reaction.

label: Keep drafts
description: Save or throw away a message you haven't sent.

label: Delete your messages
description: Removes them for everyone in the channel.

label: Update your profile
description: Your name and picture, as everyone in the chat sees them.

label: Change channel details
description: A channel's name, topic and description.

label: Change someone's role
description: Make someone an admin or a member.
